author: reek
body: The vouch walk is memoised, and this pins the one thing the memo must get right: it is keyed on the agent AND THE DEPTH.

author: reek
body: An agent's score is not a property of the agent. The walk is capped at depth 5, so the score depends on how much depth budget is left when the agent is reached: at depth 5 `best-vouch-score` asks at depth 6, the cap refuses, and the score collapses to `direct-score`. The same agent at depth 1 gets the rest of the walk.
